recentItems.title: China's Forklift Exports Rise to the Occasion
recentItems.description:
Fueled by robust overseas demand, China’s forklift exports are going up this year, with manufacturers ramping up production to meet a rush of global orders.

At this factory in east China’s Zhejiang Province, electric forklifts roll off the assembly line every two minutes, with 90 percent of them heading overseas.

Company officials say strong international demand has prompted them to expand production capacity by 40 percent this year.

But even that may not be enough, with orders now stretching through the fourth quarter.

Elsewhere in the province, another manufacturer is also pushing production into overdrive, churning out both internal combustion and electric forklifts.

On this particular day, 80 containers packed with nearly 400 forklifts were shipped overseas.

Data from the China Construction Machinery Association shows that the country’s forklift exports topped 380,000 units in the first seven months, a 22-percent increase from a year prior.

recentItems.title: China's Dexterous Robotic Hand Market Grasps the Future
recentItems.description:
You gotta hand it to China's rapidly advancing humanoid robot market, literally.

Firms that make dexterous robotic hands are undergoing three major shifts including an increase in sales volume, a decrease in product prices, and technology that's more widely available.

The head of one dexterous hand firm in Shenzhen said sales have surged this year as humanoid robots enter more application scenarios.

Plus, the fingers, fingertips and palms of these robotic hands are now covered in flexible tactile sensors, or electronic skin, allowing the hands to feel an object rather than simply grasp it.

With increased sales and a smoother supply chain, costs are coming down.

Data shows that China's dexterous hand market sold over 19,000 units in 2025 and is expected to sell 70,000 this year, and by 2030, as application scenarios expand and technology costs continue to fall, sales are projected to exceed 430,000 units.

Previously, Chinse firms were selling dexterous hand for upwards of 7,400 U.S. dollars. Now, they're going for much less.

recentItems.title: "Sky School Bus" In Mountainous Southwest China Province Eases Children's Journey to School
recentItems.description:
Two towering elevators rising from the floor of a deep canyon in southwest China's Yunnan Province have slashed the school commute for village children from more than three hours to around 30 minutes, transforming what was once a grueling daily trek into a swift vertical ascent.
